scope.qualification: Reference is a phone screen recording with app UI; do not compare its raw canvas proportions as a new art direction.

actual_reference_evidence.finding: Text/annual performance remains floating in sparse areas while market advances. 1999 +101.95% is an annual index label; +697.50% is explicitly an IPO first-day security fact and is not an index low/high return.

Historical peak baseline, trough context, and vertical range bracket give current point a spatial relation to prior extremes. 99–100s bracket/number evolves with the endpoint (+62.31% to +78.38% visible).
Reference itself uses a motivated wide-to-close cut with a narrative emphasis. Continuous work should preserve deliberate shot changes rather than prohibit every cut.

candidate_blockers.recommendation: Share camera state/clock across nodes; animate window center/span and y bounds continuously, with explicit motivated scale changes only.
